exposure: splenomegaly with a large mass at the lower medial splenic pole
outcome: diagnosis of Sclerosing Angiomatoid Nodular Transformation (SANT)
cohort: A nine-week-old female infant admitted for severe abdominal distension and rectal bleeding.
finding: The first reported case of Sclerosing Angiomatoid Nodular Transformation (SANT) was identified in a nine-week-old infant presenting with severe abdominal hemorrhage, successfully treated with splenectomy.
